Container.Name: WARNO-Dedicated-Server
Container.Overview:
This container runs Eugen's official WARNO dedicated server. The form writes login.ini, variables.ini, and params_for_ai.json for you.

Request your own login and dedicated key from eugsupport@eugensystems.com. Use the email on your EugNet account. One key can run five servers. The key is stored only in this container's settings folder. Do not put it in GitHub, and do not paste it into an issue.

The preset is a 2v2 Conquest server for Jungle Law from the Red Dragon map pack, Steam Workshop item 3811913066. Map must be the scenario ID from that mod. The words Jungle Law will not work. Players subscribe to the mod in Steam and enable it in WARNO.

Forward the game port as both TCP and UDP to this Unraid server. The container uses the host network, so there is no Docker port mapping.

For another server, add a new container from this same template. Change the container name, the game port, and the settings folder. Use the same login and key.
Container.Requires: An Eugen Systems WARNO dedicated-server login and key for the person hosting. Joining players need the game and, for Jungle Law, Steam Workshop item 3811913066.
Container.Description:
This container runs Eugen's official WARNO dedicated server. The form writes login.ini, variables.ini, and params_for_ai.json for you.

Request your own login and dedicated key from eugsupport@eugensystems.com. Use the email on your EugNet account. One key can run five servers. The key is stored only in this container's settings folder. Do not put it in GitHub, and do not paste it into an issue.

The preset is a 2v2 Conquest server for Jungle Law from the Red Dragon map pack, Steam Workshop item 3811913066. Map must be the scenario ID from that mod. The words Jungle Law will not work. After subscribing on a PC, look in steamapps/workshop/content/1611600/3811913066. Players subscribe to the mod in Steam and enable it in WARNO.

Forward the game port as both TCP and UDP to this Unraid server. The container uses the host network, so there is no Docker port mapping. The server also needs outbound internet access to reach Eugen.

For another server, add a new container from this same template. Change the container name, the game port, and the settings folder. Use the same login and key. Updating the image updates the game files. Update each container after that.

Write Config From Form rewrites the three settings files on every start. Set it to false only when you need to edit those files by hand. Hand edits are overwritten while it is true. RCON and AI decks are not on this form.

Config.Name: Settings Folder
Config.Description: Generated settings for this server, including login.ini. Use a different folder for each server, such as /mnt/user/appdata/warno2/settings. Do not commit this folder to a public repository.

Config.Name: Eugen Login
Config.Description: Login Eugen sent you for the dedicated server. This is not the login of the players who join the match.

Config.Name: Eugen Dedicated Key
Config.Description: Dedicated key Eugen sent with your login. It is written to login.ini on this server only. One key can run five servers.

Config.Name: Public WAN IP
Config.Description: Public IP address players use to reach this server. Use the WAN address of your router, not the Unraid LAN address, when the server is on the internet.

Config.Name: Game Port
Config.Description: Port the server listens on. Forward this same port as both TCP and UDP to the Unraid server. Each server container needs its own port.

Config.Name: Server Name
Config.Description: Name shown in the WARNO server browser.

Config.Name: Map
Config.Description: Scenario ID from the mod files, not the display name. Subscribe to workshop item 3811913066 and copy the Jungle Law scenario ID from steamapps/workshop/content/1611600/3811913066. Vanilla IDs look like _3x3_Airport_10vs10_CONQ.

Config.Name: Max Players
Config.Description: Total human players. A 2v2 server uses 4.

Config.Name: Minimum Players
Config.Description: Players required before the match countdown starts. Cannot be higher than Max Players.

Config.Name: Team Size
Config.Description: Maximum players on one team. A 2v2 server uses 2.

Config.Name: Combat Rule
Config.Description: 1 is Destruction. 2 is Conquest. Jungle Law is Conquest, so leave this at 2.

Config.Name: Workshop Mod List
Config.Description: Workshop mods joining players must have, written as id/version. The Red Dragon map pack is 3811913066/0. Separate extra mods with a hyphen. Clear this field to require no workshop mods.

Config.Name: Workshop Mod Tags
Config.Description: Browser icons for the required mods. Maps-Scenarios matches the Red Dragon map pack. Valid tags are Gameplay, Interface, Maps, Scenarios, Music, and Sound.

Config.Name: Write Config From Form
Config.Description: true rewrites login.ini, variables.ini, and params_for_ai.json from this form every time the container starts. Set false only to keep hand-edited files. Hand edits are overwritten while this is true.
